utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Dane, I’m spreading the word fast, but do you know the latest drop-off times and pickup plan for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m actually coming in a bit late myself, Quinn, so I don’t have the latest times yet—last I heard we still needed the exact setup spot nailed down and a clearer repair list.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Got it—I’ll keep rallying people, but I’ll ask around for the setup spot and a clearer repair list before I spread the timing any wider.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Nell, I’ve got the repair drive marked at the community center parking lot, but I want to confirm the exact entrance and start time before we tell everyone.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Good to know—it sounds like it’s happening, at least. I’ve only heard bits and pieces, so let me know once you’ve nailed down the entrance and start time.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That’s the plan, Nell—I’ll confirm the exact entrance and start time first, then we can share a clear update with everyone.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can swing by around 3:30 after school pickup, and I can bring flashlights and some work gloves if that helps.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: That helps, but can you confirm how many gloves you’re bringing, and are the flashlights working? Leo’s garage is the storage spot after Saturday, as far as I’ve heard.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can bring two pairs of work gloves, and yes, the flashlights are working with fresh batteries; I’ll drop them by around 3:30 after pickup.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Uh, I’m still a little behind on the details, Cleo, but I’m trying to pin down the time and who’s covering bikes and small appliances.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’m still mostly tracking supplies, but bikes and small appliances don’t sound fully covered yet—if you confirm the time, I’ll note that and keep asking around.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, thanks, Cleo—that helps. I’m still trying to confirm the time for next Saturday, and once I’ve got that straight I’ll let you know about bikes and small appliances too.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m fine to help, Vik, but I need to know exactly where the drop-off table is and who’s tracking what comes in before we get too far.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’d check with Cleo for the current list, Pia, but I’ve been telling folks to bring tools and pitch in since the repair drive’s going to need plenty of hands.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That’s exactly what worries me, Vik—before more people show up with things, can we confirm with Cleo where the drop-off is and who’s keeping the list?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, Hana, I’m hearing the repair drive’s really picking up—folks are bringing tools and spare parts all afternoon, though I’d still double-check the exact entrance before hauling anything over.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: That sounds promising, Tess, but I still want to confirm the time, entrance, and who’s definitely covering bike and small appliance repairs before we tell anyone to haul things over.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I think you’re right to be careful, Hana—I’ve only heard it’s this afternoon at the community center, and Mara was still waiting to confirm the bike and small appliance folks.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Oren, what time can you get there, and what tools or supplies can you bring for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right—I can get there by 9, and I can bring my toolbox, a ladder, and some spare nails if that helps.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Good—can you stay a few hours, and is that enough nails for the porch steps and fence panel?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Mara, I’ve got the repair drive at the community center lot this afternoon, and I think the big jobs are the porch steps and hall roof. If you need more than that, Jules probably has the details straighter than me.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’ve got us penciled in for next Saturday at the community center, not this afternoon, and I’m bringing the screws and drill. We’re still waiting to confirm who can cover the bike and small appliance repairs.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh—then I was mixing it up again. If it’s next Saturday at the community center, I’ll plan for that and check with Jules on who’s covering the bike and small appliance repairs.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I still have the repair drive logged at the community center parking lot this afternoon, Jules, but I want the exact entrance or corner confirmed before we send people over.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Good catch—I don’t want to guess, so let me confirm the exact corner at the community center before we send anyone over.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Perfect—once you confirm the exact corner or entrance, I’ll update my notes and let everyone know where to go.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I’m still in for Saturday morning—can you confirm the repair list, and we’ll check if we still need any hammers or work gloves?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Leo — quick update: it’s been moved to Sunday at the community center, and we’ve got Bo volunteering plus Uli bringing some tools, so let’s review the repair list and see whether we still need extra hammers or gloves.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks for the update—I can’t do Sunday, but let’s lock the repair list first and then check if we still need extra hammers or work gloves.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Yeah, I can still bring a few tools by when I head over, if that helps.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That helps, thanks. Cleo’s got the current repair list, and Opal’s tracking drop-off at the community center parking lot this afternoon, though we still need to confirm the exact entrance.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Alright, I’ll keep the tools ready and head to the parking lot this afternoon unless I hear otherwise about the entrance.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’m still out running errands, Gus, so send me the latest on timing, pickup, and who’s definitely bringing tools or helping.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I’ll be there early with the drill and both ladders, and I can help set up before folks arrive. So far I’m definitely bringing the tools, and I can text you once I hear if anyone else is locked in.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Perfect, thanks — that gives me a solid start, so text me as soon as timing and the rest of the volunteer list firm up.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I’ll be there from 9 to noon with the drill and ladders, and I can toss in some extra tape too if that helps.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Perfect, Gus—I’ll let folks know you’re bringing the drill, ladders, and tape from 9 to noon, and we can match that with Cleo’s list.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good, Vik—if Cleo’s list changes, just let me know and I’ll see what else I can round up.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: We should confirm the drop-off spot and entrance with Cleo first, since she’s got the current repair list.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Good call—before we lock anything in, let’s check with Cleo on the drop-off spot and which entrance to use, and make sure that matches the current repair list.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yeah, once Cleo confirms the spot and entrance, I can let Leo and Pia know so the details stay straight.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Mara, can you confirm you or Dev is coordinating, and send a simple list of what tools are still needed and where to store them?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’m coordinating it, and so far we still need someone confirmed for bike and small appliance repairs; store tools at the community center for next Saturday, and I’m bringing the screws and drill.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Perfect, thanks—I'll ask Sam about bike repairs and see if Gus can cover ladders, then we’ll keep tools at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: We’re kicking off around 9 at the tool table, and I’ll start by sorting the donated gear while Eli and I line up the urgent homes.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Perfect, I’m running a bit late, but I’ll swing by the tool table as soon as I can—do you know what we’re still missing for supplies or repairs?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: That helps—come by when you can; we could still use extra extension cords, work gloves, and a quick count of any tools that need testing before we head to the first houses.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m still waiting on Mara to confirm before we lock anything in, but it sounds like the porch steps and hall roof are the main repair drive jobs so far.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, but can you confirm who’s definitely organizing and what tools or volunteers are already locked in before we move ahead?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Right now Mara’s the one confirming the overall plan, and I’m just helping keep people connected; the only concrete volunteer timing I’ve heard is Faye can do 3:30 after pickup, but tools and the rest of the crew aren’t locked in yet.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Right, community center lot this afternoon—I’ll swing by and focus on the porch steps and hall roof unless you need me somewhere else first.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Bo—I've got the repair drive at the community center parking lot this afternoon, so start with the porch steps unless we confirm a different entrance-side setup first.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it—I’ll head to the community center lot this afternoon and start on the porch steps, then check in with you before I bounce to the roof.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, Nell, the repair drive’s really picking up—folks are dropping by tools and spare parts all afternoon, though I’m still trying to pin down who’s covering the bike and small appliance repairs.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That sounds promising—I’ve only heard bits and pieces, so do we have a date yet, or are they still pulling it together?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard it’s next Saturday at the community center, and Mara’s bringing screws and a drill—though I’m still waiting on firm word about who’s handling the bike and small appliance repairs.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Ira, can you confirm how many houses are still on the list and whether gloves are the main gap, or if we still need screws and tarps too?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’m still out running errands, so I can’t confirm the latest count yet—please keep me posted, and let me know if gloves are still the main gap or if screws and tarps are short too.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Okay—when you check, send me the house count and what’s still short, because I need to know whether to chase down gloves or bring screws and tarps too.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oren, have you heard the latest on drop-off times and the pickup plan? If zip ties and flashlights are still open, I can start nudging neighbors right away.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh gosh, I might be mixing things up again, Quinn, but I only know we’re starting at 9 and doing the urgent fixes first. If zip ties and flashlights are still open, please do nudge the neighbors while I check on the drop-off and pickup details.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect, I’ll start nudging folks about zip ties and flashlights now, and send everyone your way once you confirm the drop-off and pickup details.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks again, Uli—that’ll make a real difference. We’re still on for next Saturday, 10 to 2 at the community lot, and I’ll send you the final list tonight if anything shifts.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Alright, I’ll bring a few basics by then. Just send the list if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect, thank you, Uli—I’ve got you down for basics next Saturday, and I’ll message tonight only if the list shifts.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help, but 9 won’t work with school drop-off—could I swing by around 3:30 after pickup instead, and bring some work gloves?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: 3:30 works fine, Faye, and the gloves would help; I just want us to confirm the exact spot by the community center before anyone heads over.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Perfect, I’ll plan on 3:30 after pickup and bring the gloves—just send me the exact spot by the community center once you’ve got it pinned down.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Sam, I’m helping pull folks together for the repair drive—Bo said you were in already, and I wanted to check what timing works best for you.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Morning, Jules — I’m in, and I’m planning to start around 9 so I can sort the donated tools while Eli and I make a list of the urgent homes.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Perfect, thanks, Sam—that gives us a solid start at 9, and I’ll pass along that you and Eli are handling tools and the urgent-homes list.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right—I’m still sorting the signup sheet and what needs fixing first; I’ll send you the latest as soon as I’ve got it straight.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Oren—that helps; I’m still out running errands, so just send me the latest once you’ve got the signup sheet sorted.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right—I will; I’m still getting the signup sheet straight, and I’ll send you the latest as soon as I’ve got it sorted.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’ve only heard bits and pieces—what’s the latest on the repair drive, and did they finally settle on a date?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Sounds like it’s happening Saturday morning, and they’re still looking for a couple of hammers and some work gloves. I can help, but I still need to work around school drop-off and pickup.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, that helps—I’d only heard scraps. If it’s Saturday morning, I can probably come by; do you know if Quinn still needs more hands besides the hammers and gloves?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: No rush—I’ll still bring a few tools by when I head over, and we can see what still needs doing then.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Uli—I’m running a bit late, but I’ll swing by soon and help sort out whatever’s still left.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: That sounds fine—just come when you can, and I’ll set the tools down once I get there.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Kira, I have it noted by the community center parking lot, but I want to confirm the exact entrance and start time before we head over.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Before we lock it in, can you confirm which entrance at the community center and what start time we’re actually using?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Not yet—I still have it as the community center parking lot, but I want the exact entrance confirmed and a clear start time before we set anything in motion.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Bo, I’m still set to be there from 9 to noon with the drill, both ladders, and some extra tape if you need me early for setup.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Perfect—community center lot this afternoon, and the big jobs are the porch steps and the hall roof. If you can swing by a little early to help set up, that’d be great.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: You got it, Bo—I’ll swing by early with the drill, both ladders, and that extra tape so we can get set up before the porch steps and roof work start.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’d check with Cleo for the current repair list, but Opal’s still tracking the drop-off at the community center parking lot this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Good to know—I’ll check with Cleo on what’s still missing and hold off blasting it wider till Opal confirms the drop-off timing.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, that helps—once Cleo and Opal confirm it, I can keep nudging folks one-on-one about tools and extra hands.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Opal, can you confirm the repair list first? We still need a couple of hammers and work gloves for Saturday morning.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Yes—I still have the repair drive at the community center parking lot, but I want the exact entrance confirmed before we send the final list; for supplies, we still need a couple of hammers and work gloves for Saturday morning.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks—please confirm the exact entrance, then send the final list. I’ll keep asking around for the hammers and work gloves.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Rosa, I’m fine to help, but have we actually confirmed the drop-off spot by the community center and who’s keeping the list once people start bringing things?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Yes—the repair drive is Sunday at the community center, and I’m keeping the intake list myself; I’m just confirming the exact drop-off spot there now and I’ll send it around as soon as it’s locked in.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Okay, that works for me—once you send the exact spot, let’s make sure the table’s clearly marked and everyone knows where the donations get stored after drop-off.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Just making sure you’ve got it, Noah—the repair drive’s tomorrow morning, and I’ve been telling folks to bring tools and pitch in.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh—right, tomorrow morning, thanks, Vik; I probably would’ve missed that otherwise. I’ll pass it along, but I’m still a little fuzzy on the details.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, tomorrow morning—we’re sorting the order then, and I’ve been telling folks to bring tools and help out, so I’ll keep spreading the word.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Cleo, I can be there by 9—do you want me to bring gloves and tape too, or should I pick up the zip ties or flashlights?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: 9 works great—bring the zip ties if you can, since gloves and tape are already on my list, and flashlights still look unclaimed too.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it—I’ll bring the zip ties and flashlights by 9. Anything else still unclaimed besides those?
